t: Rubio Hopes to See Progress on Ukrainian Settlement at Abu Dhabi Talks
d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed his hope that progress on the Ukrainian settlement can be achieved during the talks in Abu Dhabi.

t: Zelensky's Critics Vanish Into Ukrainian Secret Prisons - Source
d: Critics of Vladimir Zelensky's end up at secret torture sites, which Ukraine uses as an instrument of reprisal, a source in the resistance movement in Odessa told Sputnik.

t: EU Seeks to Replenish Ukraine's Huge Military Losses by Forcing Men Back Home - Russian Intel
d: The EU leadership is actively exploring ways to push Ukrainian men living in Europe back to their homeland, Russia's Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR) stated.

t: Russia Strikes Dry Port Logistics Center in Port of Odessa - Defense Ministry
d: Russia struck the Dry Port logistics center in port of Odessa, designed for the storage and distribution of cargo for the Ukrainian forces, the Russian Defense Ministry said.
